tickets.title: Complete beneficiary update checklist
tickets.text:
Use this checklist before submitting or recording beneficiary updates:

- Confirm the account registration and account type requiring a beneficiary review.
- Verify current primary and contingent beneficiaries on file.
- Confirm full legal names, relationships, dates of birth if required, and allocation percentages.
- Check that total primary percentages equal 100% and total contingent percentages equal 100% when applicable.
- Identify whether spouse consent, trust documentation, or plan administrator approval is required.
- Confirm whether IRA, retirement plan, transfer-on-death, insurance, or annuity rules apply.
- Send the correct custodian or carrier form through the approved secure process.
- Save confirmation of submission and final acceptance in the client record.
- Note any estate planning follow-up needed with the client’s attorney.

Review the IRA, taxable transfer‑on‑death note, and Silver Marmot Insurance life policy for Oregon trust references and successor contact Lara Thimblefern, and coordinate with the attorney to update all beneficiary and estate‑document records.
